verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Registrar documents privacy controls around WHOIS personal data — redaction by default, ability to edit contact data — which is the closest analog to 'data retention/deletion control' for a domain registrar, but there is no documented mechanism for deleting account-level data, exporting/erasing stored records, or configuring retention periods beyond WHOIS visibility. Missing for 10: explicit account data deletion/export tooling, retention period configuration, and any GDPR-style data control beyond WHOIS redaction.
